description: 空间层级布局（2026-08-18，豆包+实测收敛）：仪式/典礼类场景用五层空间关系写死站位（前景中央跪地者/两侧贵族虚化/后方阴影隐藏威胁/更后主礼人不抢镜），显式轴侧恒定+绝对禁止清单，避免面对面模板套错、180°越轴、层级混乱。

data.kneeler_side_zh: 伊索尔德居左、罗伊娜居右，身体朝右，视线看向右后方（望向珍妮芙所在阴影）

template_zh.front_center: 前景中央：{kneelers}并肩跪在红色绒毯上（{kneelers_side}）
template_zh.side_mid: 两侧中景：贵族分列左右，虚化站定，不抢主体
template_zh.back_shadow: 后方人群阴影：{hidden}站在画面右侧人群后方，黑色兜帽长衣、脸藏阴影、不露清晰正脸，视线从右后方射向中央跪地二人
template_zh.far_altar: 更远处高台/圣坛前：{officiant}位于后景中央，暂不抢镜
template_zh.axis: 镜头全程保持同一轴侧（入口一侧：殿门内→中央跪地者→右后阴影），轴侧恒定、禁止翻到祭坛侧往回拍、禁止180°越轴
forbidden: 禁止{kneelers}与{hidden}面对面站在同一平面
禁止跪地二人拍成远景群像

template_en.front_center: foreground center: {kneelers} kneel side by side on the red carpet ({kneelers_side_en})
template_en.side_mid: midground sides: nobles line up left and right, blurred, not stealing focus
template_en.back_shadow: shadowed rear crowd: {hidden} stands behind the crowd on the right, black hooded cloak, face hidden in shadow, gaze from the right-rear toward the two kneeling women at center
template_en.far_altar: farther altar: {officiant} at the rear center, not yet claiming focus
template_en.axis: camera stays on the same axis side throughout (entrance side: doorway -> kneeling pair -> right-rear shadow); axis constant; never flip to the altar side; no 180-degree axis crossing
forbidden: do not put {hidden} in the foreground center
do not let {officiant} steal the main focus
do not face {kneelers} and {hidden} on the same plane
do not shoot the kneeling pair as a distant wide group

template_zh_scene.front_center: 前景中央：{kneelers}{kneel_phrase}红色绒毯上，面朝{facing}、背对{back}
template_zh_scene.side_mid: 两侧中景：贵族分列左右，虚化站定，不抢主体
template_zh_scene.back_shadow: 后方人群阴影：{hidden}位于跪地者背后方向（人群侧），黑色兜帽长衣、脸藏阴影、不露清晰正脸，视线射向中央跪地二人
template_zh_scene.far_altar: 更远处高台/圣坛前：{officiant}位于后景中央，暂不抢镜
template_zh_scene.axis: 镜头位于{camera_side}，观众看到跪地者的后背/侧背；镜头全程保持在{camera_side}这一侧，轴侧恒定
forbidden: 前景中央只保留跪地者，其余角色（含{hidden}）一律位于跪地者背后方向
镜头始终在{camera_side}，观众始终看到跪地者的后背/侧背

template_en_scene.front_center: foreground center: {kneelers} {kneel_phrase_en} the red carpet, facing {facing_en}, backs to {back_en}
template_en_scene.side_mid: midground sides: nobles line up left and right, blurred, not stealing focus
template_en_scene.back_shadow: shadowed rear crowd: {hidden} stands behind the kneelers (crowd side), black hooded cloak, face hidden, gaze toward the kneeling pair at center
template_en_scene.far_altar: farther altar: {officiant} at the rear center, not yet claiming focus
template_en_scene.axis: camera on the {camera_side_en}; the audience sees the kneelers' backs / side-backs; camera stays on that same side throughout, axis constant
forbidden: foreground center holds only the kneelers; {hidden} stays behind the kneelers (crowd side)
camera stays on the {camera_side_en}; audience keeps seeing the kneelers' backs / side-backs
